name: requestTimeOffCoverage
description: Reads a worker balance, reserves a coverage slot, and submits Request Time Off. Use when a manager asks to book time off and name coverage.

request_properties.name: worker_id
request_properties.description: Lab worker id, for example SYN-USER-IVAN.

request_properties.name: hours
request_properties.description: Whole hours to book. A sample value is 8.

request_properties.name: time_off_type_wid
request_properties.description: Prompt WID from list_time_off_types. Vacation is fde00000000000000000000000000031.

request_properties.name: client_request_id
request_properties.description: Caller idempotency key. A repeated key returns the original event.

request_properties.name: coverage_note
request_properties.description: Short coverage note. A sample value is Desk coverage.
